scripts._comment_env: Scripts that need POKEMMO_MAPS_DIR or R2 creds use Node's built-in --env-file-if-exists flag (Node >= 20.6). '.env.local' is loaded if present, otherwise the existing process env wins. Vite's dev/build don't need this because Vite has its own .env loader.
scripts.regen-and-sync: npm run build:map-data:sinnoh && npm run upload:maps:sync:sinnoh
scripts.regen-and-sync:sinnoh: npm run build:map-data:sinnoh && npm run upload:maps:sync:sinnoh
scripts.regen-and-sync:johto: npm run build:map-data:johto && npm run upload:maps:sync:johto
scripts._comment_predeploy: After vite build, prune dist/data/maps/<region>/{images,tiles}/ — both are hosted on R2 (absolute URLs in maps-index.json), so they're dead weight in the gh-pages branch.
scripts.predeploy: npm run build:data && npm run build && node scripts/prune-dist-for-gh-pages.mjs
scripts._comment_deploy: Custom deploy script instead of the gh-pages package. gh-pages' internal Git.rm spreads every tracked file as a separate argv to `git rm`, which on Windows blows past CreateProcess's ~32 KB command-line cap once the branch holds more than a few thousand files (we have ~600 zone WebPs + ~500 event manifests + ~500 walkable sidecars + ~5000 overworld tiles per region). Our script uses `git worktree` + a single `git rm -rf .` cleanup so the argv stays tiny regardless of file count.
